config.label: User API key from zeropointlogic
config.description: User API key from zeropointlogic.io/dashboard/api-keys. Format: zpl_u_ + 48 hex chars. Service keys (zpl_s_) are rejected since v3.5.0.

config.label: pure (default) hides AIN score from the AI on text-evaluation tools to prevent observer effect
config.description: pure (default) hides AIN score from the AI on text-evaluation tools to prevent observer effect. coach exposes the score.

config.label: Engine base URL
config.description: Engine base URL. Defaults to https://engine.zeropointlogic.io.

config.label: Only required for the 8 AI-eval tools (zpl_consistency_test, zpl_sycophancy_score, etc)
config.description: Only required for the 8 AI-eval tools (zpl_consistency_test, zpl_sycophancy_score, etc). Session capped at 100 Claude calls per process.
